import numpy as np
im = Image.open('barcode.png').convert('RGB')
a = np.asarray(im).astype(float)
colmean = a.mean(axis=0)  # 1000 x 3
lum = colmean.mean(axis=1)
# find red-dominant columns: R much greater than G and B
r, g, b = colmean[:,0], colmean[:,1], colmean[:,2]
redmask = (r > g*1.5) & (r > b*1.8) & (r > 40)
print("red-dominant columns (%):", (np.where(redmask)[0]/10).round(1)[:50])
# bright columns
bright = lum > 100
idx = np.where(bright)[0]
# group into runs
runs=[]
if len(idx):
    start=idx[0]; prev=idx[0]
    for i in idx[1:]:
        if i>prev+1:
            runs.append((start,prev)); start=i
        prev=i
    runs.append((start,prev))
print("bright runs (%):", [(s/10, e/10) for s,e in runs])
# max luminance location
print("max lum col at %:", lum.argmax()/10, "val", lum.max())
# teal columns: b > r*1.3
teal = (b > r*1.35) & (b > 30) & (lum>25)
print("teal-dominant % range:", (np.where(teal)[0]/10).min(), (np.where(teal)[0]/10).max())

            runs.append((start,prev)); start=i
        prev=i
    runs.append((start,prev))
print("amber runs (%):", [(s/10, e/10) for s,e in runs])
